**[Open 1% cada día](https://mision-15-87f9fa.gitlab.io/)**

## How it works

I built 1% cada día to make short exercise sessions easier to fit into a daily routine. The **Hoy** screen lets me log exercises I have already done or continue a guided 15-minute session. The weekly plan is editable, and the progress view shows logged activity over time.

## How I built it

I used React and TypeScript for the interface and Vite to build it as an installable progressive web app. IndexedDB stores records in the browser when no account is connected. A service worker caches the interface so it can reopen offline after an initial online load. GitLab Pages serves the built app.

The public link opens the interface, not my account or exercise history.
